report.explanation: Alert claims checkout error-rate and latency, but current telemetry is largely healthy: gateway error_rate 0.0014, p95 76ms, INFO 200 logs, order checkout OK. Only a single gateway ERROR span to order and order WARN retained-heap logs appear. Deployment record proves version facts only. Evidence is insufficient to bound any taxonomy cause; hand off for more data.

Order checkout span is OK at 1050ms; need per-endpoint latency/error breakdown to confirm or refute downstream latency.
No evidence of HTTP 500s, db pool exhaustion, redis timeouts, or bad configuration in current telemetry.
Memory retention facts are absent (memory_retention_by_service empty); a single retained_after_gc sample cannot establish a leak.
